recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. If a future work group wants a current StructureDefinition/Questionnaire mechanism for linking profiles to logical-model data dictionaries, it should be specified as a new current-scope tracker rather than resurrecting this retired DSTU1 DataElement extension.
issue_request: FHIR-5730 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 change request to create a standard extension linking a profile, especially on Observation and potentially Questionnaire, to a collection of DataElement definitions.
initial_application: The request was applied in SVN revision 4145, represented in git by 0e157c65121f04ce866204b6842b180a1039d5cc, which added source/dataelement/dataelement-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with the datadictionary extension. Later same-day history also added dictionary configuration support for HSPC profiles.
additional_context: DataElement is no longer an active current-build resource: source/fhir.ini has DataElement entries commented out, source/dataelement is absent, and FHIR-13094 records the later Published decision to collapse DataElement into StructureDefinition logical models. The current checkout contains datadictionary only in release-history bundles and an old template placeholder, not in active core or Extension Pack source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing the DSTU1 datadictionary extension into the current core build would revive an obsolete DataElement-specific mechanism after DataElement was removed from the current specification.

related_jiras.note: Published decision to collapse DataElement into StructureDefinition logical models explains why the old DataElement datadictionary extension is no longer current build content.
